// Independent graph oracles: Floyd-Warshall and exhaustive 2-color assignments.
// Executes against the unmodified SDK emitted by the real Quds compiler.
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'quds_math.dart' as m;

var checks = 0;
var graphs = 0;
void check(bool condition, String context) {
  checks++;
  if (!condition) throw StateError(context);
}

void same(Object actual, Object expected, String context) => check(
    jsonEncode(actual) == jsonEncode(expected),
    '$context: $actual != $expected');
void rejects(void Function() action, String message) {
  Object? error;
  try {
    action();
  } catch (caught) {
    error = caught;
  }
  check(error == message, 'expected "$message", got "$error"');
}

List<List<int>> groups(List<List<bool>> relation) {
  final used = <int>{};
  final output = <List<int>>[];
  for (var i = 0; i < relation.length; i++) {
    if (used.contains(i)) continue;
    final members = <int>[];
    for (var j = 0; j < relation.length; j++) {
      if (relation[i][j]) {
        members.add(j);
        used.add(j);
      }
    }
    output.add(members);
  }
  return output;
}

void verify(List<List<int>> graph) {
  graphs++;
  final snapshot = jsonEncode(graph);
  final n = graph.length;
  final distances =
      List.generate(n, (i) => List.generate(n, (j) => i == j ? 0 : n + 1));
  final weak = List.generate(n, (i) => List.generate(n, (j) => i == j));
  final reversed = List.generate(n, (_) => <int>[]);
  for (var u = 0; u < n; u++) {
    for (final v in graph[u]) {
      if (u != v) distances[u][v] = 1;
      weak[u][v] = weak[v][u] = true;
      reversed[v].add(u);
    }
  }
  for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        distances[i][j] =
            math.min(distances[i][j], distances[i][k] + distances[k][j]);
        weak[i][j] = weak[i][j] || (weak[i][k] && weak[k][j]);
      }
    }
  }
  final reach =
      List.generate(n, (i) => List.generate(n, (j) => distances[i][j] <= n));
  final mutual = List.generate(
      n, (i) => List.generate(n, (j) => reach[i][j] && reach[j][i]));
  same(m.transposeGraph(graph), reversed, 'transpose graph=$snapshot');
  same(m.transitiveClosure(graph), reach, 'closure graph=$snapshot');
  same(
      m.weaklyConnectedComponents(graph), groups(weak), 'weak graph=$snapshot');
  same(m.stronglyConnectedComponents(graph), groups(mutual),
      'strong graph=$snapshot');
  for (var source = 0; source < n; source++) {
    same(
        m.bfsDistances(graph, source),
        [
          for (final distance in distances[source])
            distance <= n ? distance : -1
        ],
        'distances source=$source graph=$snapshot');
    for (var target = 0; target < n; target++) {
      final path = m.shortestUnweightedPath(graph, source, target);
      if (!reach[source][target]) {
        check(path.isEmpty, 'unreachable path graph=$snapshot');
      } else {
        check(
            path.length == distances[source][target] + 1 &&
                path.first == source &&
                path.last == target,
            'shortest path endpoints/length graph=$snapshot');
        check(path.toSet().length == path.length, 'path repeats a vertex');
        for (var i = 1; i < path.length; i++) {
          check(graph[path[i - 1]].contains(path[i]), 'path uses missing edge');
        }
      }
    }
  }
  var cyclic = false;
  for (var u = 0; u < n; u++) {
    for (final v in graph[u]) {
      cyclic |= reach[v][u];
    }
  }
  if (cyclic) {
    rejects(() {
      m.topologicalSort(graph);
    }, 'topologicalSort needs an acyclic graph');
  } else {
    final order = m.topologicalSort(graph);
    same(order.toList()..sort(), List.generate(n, (i) => i),
        'topological permutation');
    for (var u = 0; u < n; u++) {
      for (final v in graph[u]) {
        check(order.indexOf(u) < order.indexOf(v), 'topological edge order');
      }
    }
    same(m.topologicalSort(graph), order, 'deterministic topology');
  }
  // This deliberately uses an independent exponential oracle on small graphs.
  var colorable = false;
  for (var mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
    var valid = true;
    for (var u = 0; u < n; u++) {
      for (final v in graph[u]) {
        if (((mask >> u) & 1) == ((mask >> v) & 1)) valid = false;
      }
    }
    if (valid) {
      colorable = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (colorable) {
    final colors = m.bipartiteColoring(graph);
    check(colors.length == n && colors.every((v) => v == 0 || v == 1),
        'color range');
    for (final component in groups(weak)) {
      check(colors[component.first] == 0, 'canonical component color');
    }
    for (var u = 0; u < n; u++) {
      for (final v in graph[u]) {
        check(colors[u] != colors[v], 'color constraint');
      }
    }
  } else {
    rejects(() {
      m.bipartiteColoring(graph);
    }, 'bipartiteColoring needs a bipartite graph');
  }
  check(jsonEncode(graph) == snapshot, 'input graph was mutated');
}

void main() {
  // Every directed graph with loops through 3 vertices (531 graphs).
  for (var n = 0; n <= 3; n++) {
    for (var mask = 0; mask < (1 << (n * n)); mask++) {
      verify(List.generate(
          n,
          (u) => [
                for (var v = 0; v < n; v++)
                  if ((mask & (1 << (u * n + v))) != 0) v
              ]));
    }
  }
  // Every simple undirected graph through 5 vertices (1100 graphs).
  for (var n = 0; n <= 5; n++) {
    for (var mask = 0; mask < (1 << (n * (n - 1) ~/ 2)); mask++) {
      final graph = List.generate(n, (_) => <int>[]);
      var bit = 0;
      for (var u = 0; u < n; u++) {
        for (var v = u + 1; v < n; v++) {
          if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
            graph[u].add(v);
            graph[v].add(u);
          }
          bit++;
        }
      }
      verify(graph);
    }
  }
  // Larger fixed-seed directed multigraphs (loops/duplicates/disconnected).
  final random = math.Random(41207);
  for (var trial = 0; trial < 64; trial++) {
    final graph = List.generate(7, (_) => <int>[]);
    for (var edge = 0; edge < trial; edge++) {
      graph[random.nextInt(7)].add(random.nextInt(7));
    }
    verify(graph);
  }
  same(
      m.shortestUnweightedPath([
        [2, 1],
        [3],
        [3],
        []
      ], 0, 3),
      [0, 2, 3],
      'path tie ordering');
  same(
      m.topologicalSort([
        [2, 2],
        [2],
        [3],
        []
      ]),
      [0, 1, 2, 3],
      'Kahn FIFO ordering');
  for (final invalid in <List<List<int>>>[
    [
      [-1]
    ],
    [
      [],
      [2]
    ]
  ]) {
    for (final action in <void Function()>[
      () {
        m.transposeGraph(invalid);
      },
      () {
        m.bfsDistances(invalid, 0);
      },
      () {
        m.shortestUnweightedPath(invalid, 0, 0);
      },
      () {
        m.weaklyConnectedComponents(invalid);
      },
      () {
        m.stronglyConnectedComponents(invalid);
      },
      () {
        m.topologicalSort(invalid);
      },
      () {
        m.bipartiteColoring(invalid);
      },
      () {
        m.transitiveClosure(invalid);
      },
    ]) {
      rejects(action, 'graph vertex out of range');
    }
  }
  for (final source in [-1, 1]) {
    rejects(() {
      m.bfsDistances([[]], source);
    }, 'graph source out of range');
    rejects(() {
      m.shortestUnweightedPath([[]], source, 0);
    }, 'graph source out of range');
    rejects(() {
      m.shortestUnweightedPath([[]], 0, source);
    }, 'graph target out of range');
  }
  rejects(() {
    m.bfsDistances([], 0);
  }, 'graph source out of range');
  rejects(() {
    m.shortestUnweightedPath([], 0, 0);
  }, 'graph source out of range');
  final original = <List<int>>[
    [1],
    [0],
    []
  ];
  final transpose = m.transposeGraph(original);
  transpose[0].add(2);
  same(
      original,
      [
        [1],
        [0],
        []
      ],
      'transpose must not alias input');
  final strong = m.stronglyConnectedComponents(original);
  strong[0].add(2);
  same(
      original,
      [
        [1],
        [0],
        []
      ],
      'components must not alias input');
  final closure = m.transitiveClosure(original);
  closure[0][2] = true;
  check(!closure[1][2] && closure[2][2], 'closure rows must not alias');
  // Deep chain: linear work and iterative DFS, without calling dense closure.
  const n = 20000;
  final chain = List.generate(n, (u) => u + 1 < n ? [u + 1] : <int>[]);
  check(m.bfsDistances(chain, 0).last == n - 1, 'large chain distance');
  check(m.shortestUnweightedPath(chain, 0, n - 1).length == n,
      'large chain path');
  same(m.topologicalSort(chain), List.generate(n, (i) => i),
      'large chain topology');
  final strongChain = m.stronglyConnectedComponents(chain);
  check(
      strongChain.length == n &&
          strongChain.first.single == 0 &&
          strongChain.last.single == n - 1,
      'large chain strongly connected components');
  check(m.weaklyConnectedComponents(chain).single.length == n,
      'large chain weak component');
  check(m.bipartiteColoring(chain).last == 1, 'large chain coloring');
  print('GRAPH CHECKS=$checks GRAPHS=$graphs FAILURES=0');
}
